message:
chore(release): 0.2.21 (#188)

Cuts **0.2.21**. Release-only changes: the `pyproject.toml` version,
`uv.lock`, `CHANGELOG.md` (`[Unreleased]` → `[0.2.21] - 2026-10-06`) and
an `UPGRADES.yaml` block.

| PR | Change |
|---|---|
| #185 | **`alembic upgrade head` works again in projects without
`--mcp-client`** (broken since 0.2.19). `test_migrations.py` no longer
skips on a broken chain, and a matrix check guards the chain. Migrations
and tests also work without an AI framework |
| #184 | A conversation resumed on a new connection keeps its context
(Pydantic AI, PydanticDeep) |
| #186 | Bulk deletion of non-admin users forgets their agent memory |
| #187 | Deep research sends withheld text if a run ends on that step
(guard for #176) |

`UPGRADES.yaml` (0.2.21) has one manual step: run `alembic upgrade
head`. Projects without the MCP client were stuck at 0025.
